target: Implement real ConPort decision/progress writers and dope-memory mirror behind the existing typed approval-phrase gate
invariants: task-orchestrator never becomes the memory authority
ConPort remains canonical writer for decisions and progress
dope-memory mirror writes only follow a successful ConPort write
Every write emits a receipt naming canonical_writer, requested_by, approval_id, source_packet, upstream_response, and mirror_status
Missing or invalid approval phrase MUST refuse the write
Mirror failure leaves ConPort state intact and surfaces PARTIAL (no rollback of canonical write)
No bridge surface is treated as canonical
Cross-system writes are routed via the existing PM helpers; no new direct DB clients are added

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): live ConPort/dope-memory writers behind approval gate

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): live ConPort/dope-memory writers behind approval gate
pr.body: Adds the canonical ConPort write client and dope-memory mirror behind the existing typed-approval gate from TP-DMX-ORCH-004. Receipts name canonical_writer + mirror_status. Mirror failure leaves canonical ConPort state intact and reports PARTIAL. Independent Gemini audit required per the architecture-sensitive PAL chain.

steps.task: Inspect existing PM write paths in src/dopemux/pm/ to identify the canonical ConPort and dope-memory client surfaces and enumerate duplicate-writer hazards.
validation: Evidence ledger lists each PM write helper, its canonical writer, and whether it currently bypasses approval.
Any duplicate-writer or bridge-as-writer hazards are flagged with file:line evidence.

steps.task: Define the WriteReceipt dataclass/Pydantic model with canonical_writer, requested_by, approval_id, source_packet, upstream_response, mirror_writer, mirror_status, status, idempotency_key, and chain_of_custody.
validation: Receipt fixtures round-trip via the chosen schema validator.
Mirror failure produces a receipt with mirror_status: FAILED and overall status: PARTIAL.
Receipt JSON renders deterministically (sorted keys).

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/memory_writers.py::write_decision routed to ConPort only via the existing PM helper.
validation: Tests mock ConPort success and failure; on failure, no dope-memory write occurs.
Missing approval phrase refuses with a deterministic error code.
Receipt names ConPort as canonical_writer; mirror_writer is null.

steps.task: Implement write_progress with a dope-memory mirror after a successful ConPort write.
validation: Tests cover mirror success, mirror failure, ConPort failure.
Mirror failure must NOT roll back ConPort; the receipt is PARTIAL with mirror_status: FAILED.
Receipt names ConPort canonical_writer and dope-memory mirror_writer.

steps.task: Reuse approve_phrase() and the approval_policy classifier so every write checks the typed approval against the receipt's operation/resource/writer/proof_id tuple.
validation: Invalid or absent approval phrase always refuses, with a deterministic error code.
Approval mismatch (wrong operation, wrong resource, or wrong writer) refuses.
Approval policy regressions are caught by the existing test_policy.py suite plus new fixtures.

steps.task: Wire CLI subcommands `orchestrator memory record_decision` and `orchestrator memory record_progress` to the new writers; require --approval-phrase and emit JSON receipts.
validation: CLI tests reject missing approval, accept valid approval with mocked upstream, and produce deterministic JSON receipts.
CLI exits non-zero on refusal.

steps.task: Add tests/integration/orchestrator/test_memory_writers_integration.py that exercises the writers against in-process mocks of ConPort and dope-memory.
validation: Integration tests pass without real network calls.
Fixtures cover the full receipt lifecycle: success, partial mirror failure, full failure, refusal.

steps.task: Run pal/secaudit on the write paths; ensure no secret leakage in receipts, no unsafe stringification of upstream responses, and no path-traversal on proof_id.
validation: secaudit report attached to the PR with no high-severity findings open.
Any medium/low findings are tracked as follow-up issues.

steps.task: Emit proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-009-LIVE/PROOF.json with the full validations array, codereview/precommit status, secaudit reference, not_run (live ConPort/dope-memory DB writes), residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: dopemux orchestrator proof validate exits 0.
Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after the receipt-lifecycle matrix passes and secaudit shows no high findings.
